name: payflow
description: PayFlow — a payment processing simulator with a Fastify API and a React operations console

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @payflow/web && npm run build -w @payflow/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @payflow/api && npm run typecheck -w @payflow/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
